text.text_excerpt: We were having a lazy night in and decided to get food delivered through an app. I had never heard of this place before so we decided to give it a try and I'm happy we did. I was indecisive and got an order of the kicking bourbon wings and the chicken bacon ranch potato. The wings were my favorite! They had a tiny bit of kick to the balance out the sweetness and were cooked perfectly. The potato was huge and I definitely had half leftover. It could have used some extra toppings because it's a lot of potato to eat with it, but overall I was happy with my choice. My SO got the Buffalo chicken potato and a side of macaroni and cheese. I had a bite of his potato and thought it had great flavo...

Lawwwwddddd the food was delicious! Mr. Potato did not disappoint! Y'all give them a try whenever you can! The portions were large and the food was amazing! We ordered Shrimp and French Fries with a side of seafood sauce, The Chicken Alfredo Potato ( my personal favorite), Buffalo hot wings with Fries, seafood Mac&Cheese, Chicken Bacon Ranch Potato and the Buffalo Chicken potatoe. Everybody enjoyed what they ordered so flavorful and delicious!

Pandemic delivery review: I read about this new spot near work and since there were only a few of us on site on a slow Friday, I asked around about who wanted potatoes for lunch! We ordered 3 baked potatoes, 2 orders of fries and 1 shrimp/fries via a delivery app. WOW! This was a ton of food. The shrimp and fries were plentiful for the price. The baked potatoes were HUGE! I got a seafood potato and a broccoli & cheese (to save for later). I must have gotten 4 or 5 meals out of these. The sauce was great... a mix of melted cheese and cheese sauce.
